q1_issues.issue: "on a new roof" is rendered as a thematic role (Theme sk_decision_1 sk_roof_1) instead of the preposition-named oblique the instruction set requires for a PP naming what something is about or directed at ("work on the mural" -> (On ...)), so a near-fit role head replaces the preposition actually used.

q2_gaps: PP complement of a noun ("a decision on a new roof"): preposition-named obliques are specified for attachment to an event, and the only entity-attached case given is "from" (origin); no rule states how a noun's own PP argument attaches or whether it may carry a thematic role
notes: Collective-noun subject (no GroupOf, no distribution rule), descriptive "new" left unfused as a separate Member, Patient for the created decision, and the absent tense atom on the bare simple present are all as the instruction set specifies.
